about: Rules for python -m lift benchmark split (lift/score/benchmark.py). Held-out players come from the E84 pre-registration (/mnt/project-files/experiments/e84_preregistration.md, Austin's go 2026-11-14): every record by them is benchmark, never training. The E81 benchmark songs (benchmark_tags.json) stay benchmark too. Austin's test tunes are their own group. extra_share: this share of the other sessions (same player and year; a record without a year is its own session) joins the benchmark too, picked by a hash of the session's name so it never changes as the ledger grows. 0.2 chosen by Austin (Build, 2026-11-20); 0 = held-out players and E81 songs only.
